items.originalTitle: Colton Herta replaced at Hitech to end poor F2 season early
items.summaryEn: Colton Herta will not contest the final two rounds of the 2026 Formula 2 season after reaching a "mutual agreement" with Hitech, ending his difficult campaign early. The nine-time IndyCar race winner moved to European single-seaters this year in a bid to earn the FIA Superlicence required to compete in Formula 1.
detailZh: 赫塔在Hitech被替换，提前结束表现不佳的F2赛季
赫塔将不会参加2026年F2赛季最后两轮比赛
科尔顿·赫塔与Hitech达成“双方协议”，将不会参加2026年F2赛季最后两轮比赛，提前结束这段艰难征程。
这位九次IndyCar分站冠军今年转战欧洲单座赛事，目标是取得参加F1所需的FIA超级驾照。
但对赫塔来说，F2 的进展并不如计划，他在积分榜上排名第 19，12 轮比赛仅获得 26 分，最好成绩是在巴塞罗那从倒序发车第三位起步获得第五名。
这位 26 岁的美国车手不会参加卡塔尔和阿布扎比的最后两个比赛周末，将由罗曼·比利宾斯基顶替——后者原本就计划在 2027 年接替赫塔的席位。
Hitech F2 赛事工程主管扬·苏曼表示：“我们很高兴欢迎罗曼加入 Hitech，参加本赛季最后两轮比赛。
“这两个周末将给我们机会，在冬季之前开始建立重要的关系。”
“我还要感谢科尔顿在效力 Hitech 期间所展现的投入与决心，尽管这个赛季充满挑战。我们祝愿他未来一切顺利。”
车队声明中没有引用赫塔的话，目前也尚不清楚他明年的计划，因为尽管赛季表现不佳，他仍曾有望晋升 F1。
这是通过他担任凯迪拉克储备车手的角色实现的，并且得益于 2026 年的六次第一节练习赛出场，他现在已经获得了超级驾照，但就在获得之后几天，瓦尔特利·博塔斯被确认将于明年与塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯搭档。
至于他在 Hitech 的替代者，比利恩斯基今年也参加了他的 F2 新秀赛季，但表现也好不了多少，以 36 分位列车手积分榜第 16 位，效力于 DAMS。
“我非常期待在赛季最后两站加入Hitech。能在2027年之前有机会与车队合作，真是额外的收获，”这位22岁的波兰裔英国车手说道，他在2025年F3中获得第11名。
“这意味着我们可以立即开始合作，相互了解，并在明年之前打下坚实的基础。当然，我希望能在本赛季收官阶段取得一些强劲的成绩。”
detailEn: Colton Herta replaced at Hitech to end poor F2 season early
Herta will not contest the final two rounds of the 2026 Formula 2 campaign
Colton Herta will end his torrid time in Formula 2 early by not returning for the final two rounds of the 2026 season following a “mutual agreement” with Hitech.
The nine-time IndyCar race winner made the transition to European single-seaters this year as part of his bid to gain an FIA Superlicence that is required to compare in Formula 1.
But F2 has not gone as planned for Herta, who is 19th in the standings with only 26 points from 12 rounds, achieving a best result of fifth at Barcelona from third on a reversed grid.
The 26-year-old American is not returning for the final race weekends in Qatar and Abu Dhabi and will be replaced by Roman Bilinski - who was already set to take Herta’s seat in 2027.
Jan Sumann, Hitech's F2 head of race engineering said: “We're delighted to welcome Roman to Hitech for the final two rounds of the season.
“These two weekends will give us an opportunity to start building important relationships before the winter.
“I would also like to thank Colton for his commitment and determination throughout his time with Hitech, despite a challenging season. We wish him the very best for the future.”
Herta was not quoted in the team statement and it is not yet known what his plans for next year are because, despite a poor season, he was still in the frame for an F1 promotion.

That was via his role as Cadillac’s reserve driver and thanks to six FP1 appearances in 2026, he has now obtained a superlicence but days after doing so, Valtteri Bottas was confirmed for next year alongside Sergio Perez.
As for his replacement at Hitech, Bilinski also contested his rookie F2 campaign this year but didn’t fare much better, sitting 16th in the standings with 36 points for DAMS.

“I'm really excited to be joining Hitech for the final two rounds of the season. Having the opportunity to work with the team ahead of 2027 is a real bonus,” said the 22-year-old Polish-Briton, who finished 11th in F3 in 2025.

“It means we can start working together straight away, get to know each other and build a strong foundation ahead of next year. Of course, I’ll be hoping for some strong results to close out the current season.”

items.originalTitle: Salary dispute holding up Ollie Bearman’s new Haas F1 deal
items.summaryEn: Motorsport.com understands that financial terms are behind the delay in confirming Ollie Bearman for 2027, with Ferrari having already exercised its option on the British driver. Bearman is currently the only driver on the Formula 1 grid without a contract for 2027.
detailZh: 薪资分歧拖延奥利·贝尔曼与哈斯F1车队的新合同
Motorsport.com获悉，财务条款是贝尔曼2027年合同迟迟未获确认的原因，法拉利已行使对这位英国车手的选项。
法拉利青训车手奥利弗·贝尔曼仍是F1发车阵容中唯一没有2027年合同的车手。考虑到自去年夏天以来，他留在哈斯一直被视作理所当然，这种情况在几周前还难以想象。
在巴西大奖赛前宣布拉斐尔·卡马拉为贝尔曼2027年的队友后，外界原本预计很快会公布这位英国队友的续约。然而沉默一直延续，甚至成为话题，还引发了贝尔曼明年转投其他车队的传闻。矛盾之处在于，贝尔曼与哈斯都有充分理由达成协议。
贝尔曼已排除2027年转投其他车队参赛的可能性，而哈斯车队长期以来一直被预计会留用他，但谈判拖延的时间远超最初预期。
最近几周，外界对僵局原因有诸多猜测，其中一些与贝尔曼和法拉利之间的合同关系以及这位21岁英国车手的未来前景有关。
然而，根据Motorsport.com获得的信息，阻碍签约的问题并不涉及车手的长期未来，而是与哈斯车队合同中的财务条款有关。
法拉利已经行使了选择权，允许其将贝尔曼保留在车手培养计划中。鉴于自2021年贝尔曼加入车手学院以来，马拉内罗方面一直在这位年轻英国车手身上投入资金资源，允许贝尔曼免费转会离开将是对所有这些努力的一大浪费。
拉斐尔·卡马拉将为哈斯车队完成2026赛季，同时为2027年与奥利弗·贝尔曼搭档的完整首秀做准备。
如果贝尔曼在2027年底前仍未收到加入厂队的征召，他可能会处于离开法拉利的位置，但这一情形并不构成与哈斯续约的障碍，也无需在短期内敲定他与法拉利的关系——尤其是考虑到刘易斯·汉密尔顿正处于职业生涯的暮年。法拉利车队并未排除任何长期选项。
因此，眼前的谈判集中在两方：哈斯和贝尔曼的团队。症结在于美国车队提供的薪水，车手及其团队认为这一数字与他们的期望不相称。
这导致了长时间的僵局，尽管双方都清楚达成协议的必要性。在拉斯维加斯大奖赛前夕，贝尔曼毫不掩饰自己对这一已拖延数月局面的失望。“没有什么新消息可说。说实话，在赛季第20站时发现自己还没有明年的合同，我相当失望。这是个奇怪的局面，但我们正在推进。”
这位英国车手承认，这种不确定性正变得难以应对，尤其是在他自认为已经证明了自己作为车队头号车手价值的这个赛季之后。
不过，贝尔曼断然排除了2027年转投其他车队的可能性。当被问及是否还有哪怕一丝可能去别处参赛——在已没有更多席位可供真正讨论的情况下——他的回答毫不含糊：“不，零可能。”
他补充道：“我2027年的目标非常明确。我认为我们在这里还有未竟的事业。然后再往更远的未来看，那其实并不完全掌握在我手中，这么说吧。”
贝尔曼一直公开表达自己渴望有朝一日能去马拉内罗，但他也清楚，关于法拉利车队未来的决定并不只取决于他的表现。
“当然，我与法拉利有合同。法拉利给了我这次不可思议的机会，让我第一次和他们一起进入F1，”他承认道。“我仍然是法拉利的青训车手，我的终极梦想是为法拉利比赛。首先，他们是最具标志性的车队，也是第一个在我小时候就相信我的车队。”
“这仍然是我的终极梦想，但毫无疑问，展望未来，那里可能会有一些挑战。不可否认，这非常清楚。我在这件事上真的没有太多发言权。我们只需要看看事情随着时间的推移如何发展。”
眼前的合同情况更为直接。法拉利已经澄清了其合同立场，并不是阻碍贝尔曼确认的一方。正在进行的谈判仅涉及车手与哈斯之间协议的条款。根据Motorsport.com收集的信息，此事预计将在阿布扎比的最后一个比赛周末之前解决，很可能通过在财务方面不可避免的妥协来实现。
但这并不能让贝尔曼在11月底仍未达成协议的事实变得不那么令人沮丧。“在还剩两场比赛的情况下坐在这里，事情还没有解决，这种感觉并不好，”他说。“尽管我知道我们差不多已经到了那一步，但事实是我们并没有。老实说，在没有签署合同的情况下坐在这里，没有任何借口。”
这些言论表明，整场拉锯战对这位车手造成了多大的心理负担。除非谈判出现意外破裂，否则贝尔曼预计将在2027年继续留在哈斯车队，与卡马拉组成围场中最年轻的车手组合之一。
detailEn: Salary dispute holding up Ollie Bearman’s new Haas F1 deal
Motorsport.com understands financial terms are behind the delay in confirming Ollie Bearman for 2027, with Ferrari having already exercised its option on the British driver

Ferrari protege Oliver Bearman remains the only driver on the Formula 1 grid without a contract for 2027. It is a situation that would have been hard to imagine just a few weeks ago, given that his retention at Haas had been taken for granted since last summer.

The announcement of Rafael Camara as Bearman's 2027 team-mate, which came ahead of the Brazilian Grand Prix, was expected to be swiftly followed by that of his British team-mate. Instead, the silence has dragged on to the point of becoming a talking point, even prompting rumours of Bearman driving elsewhere next year. The paradox is that Bearman and Haas have strong reasons to reach an agreement.
Bearman has ruled out racing elsewhere in 2027, while Haas has long been expected to retain him, yet the negotiations have dragged on far longer than initially anticipated.

In recent weeks, there has been speculation about the reasons for the deadlock, some linked to the contractual relationship between Bearman and Ferrari and to the future prospects of the 21-year-old Briton.
According to information obtained by Motorsport.com, however, the issue holding up the signing does not concern the driver’s long-term future, but rather the financial terms of the deal with Haas.

Ferrari has already exercised the option allowing it to retain Bearman within its driver programme. Given that Maranello has invested financial resources in the young Briton ever since he joined the Driver Academy in 2021, allowing Bearman to leave on a free transfer would be a big waste of all those efforts.
Rafael Camara will finish the 2026 season for Haas as he prepares for his full 2027 debut alongside Oliver Bearman.

Bearman could be in a position to leave Ferrari at the end of 2027 if he has not received a call-up to join the works team, but this scenario does not represent an obstacle to renewing with Haas, and there is no need to finalise his relationship with Ferrari in the short term – especially given that Lewis Hamilton is in the twilight of his career. The Scuderia has not ruled out any of its longer-term options.

The immediate negotiations therefore centre on two parties: Haas and Bearman’s entourage. The sticking point is the salary offered by the American team, a figure that the driver and his staff do not consider commensurate with their expectations.

This has led to a prolonged deadlock, despite both sides being aware of the need to reach an agreement. On the eve of the Las Vegas Grand Prix, Bearman made no secret of his disappointment at a situation that has now been dragging on for months. “There’s nothing new to say. To be honest, I’m rather disappointed to find myself here, at the twentieth round of the season, without a signed contract for next year. It’s a strange situation, but we’re getting there.”
The Briton admitted that the uncertainty is becoming difficult to cope with, especially after a season in which he believes he has proved his worth as the team's lead driver.

Bearman categorically ruled out the possibility of moving to another team in 2027, though. When asked if there was even the slightest chance of racing elsewhere, with no more seats up for real discussion, his answer was unequivocal: "No, zero chance."
He added: "My goal for 2027 is very clear. I think we have unfinished business here. Then looking further into the future, it's not really in my hands, let's say it like that."
Bearman has been open about his ambition to make it to Maranello, but he is aware that decisions regarding the Scuderia’s future do not depend solely on his performance.

"Of course I'm under contract with Ferrari. Ferrari have given me this incredible opportunity to step into F1 with them for the first time," he acknowledged. "I'm still a Ferrari junior driver and my ultimate dream is to race for Ferrari. First of all, they're the most iconic team and they're the first team that believed in me as a kid.

"It's still my ultimate dream, but there's no doubt that looking into the future, there may be some challenges there. There's no denying that, it's very clear. I don't really have much say in the matter. We just need to see how things develop over time."

The immediate contract situation is more straightforward. Ferrari has already clarified its contractual position and is not the party holding up Bearman’s confirmation. The ongoing negotiations concern only the terms of the agreement between the driver and Haas. According to information gathered by Motorsport.com, the matter is expected to be resolved before the final weekend in Abu Dhabi, in all likelihood through an inevitable compromise on the financial front.

That doesn't make the lack of a deal by the end of November any less frustrating for Bearman. "It's not a good feeling to be sitting here with two races to go without things sorted out," he said. "Even though I know that we're pretty much there, the fact is that we're not. There's no excuse for being here without a contract signed, quite honestly."

Those comments show just how much this whole tug-of-war has weighed on the driver. Barring an unexpected breakdown in negotiations, Bearman is expected to remain with Haas in 2027 as well, forming one of the youngest driver pairings on the grid alongside Camara.

贝尔曼与哈斯双方都有充分理由达成协议，但沉默持续发酵，甚至引发了贝尔曼明年转投其他车队的传闻。

items.originalTitle: Edd Straw's F1 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix driver rankings
detailZh: 谁在F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛的疯狂超车盛宴中表现最好（和最差）？
这是Edd Straw在他的新等级排名驾驶员格式中的判断。
通常，您可以通过在The Race Members' Club的这篇帖子下评论来询问Edd的排名 - 并尝试使用我们方便的视觉工具编制自己的巴西大奖赛等级列表！
马克斯·维斯塔潘在排位赛中表现出色，尽管他只因为基米·安东内利的处罚而继承了杆位，但他最初的结果落后只是因为梅赛德斯车手的巨大牵引。
但真正让维斯塔潘脱颖而出的是这场比赛：他领先超过90%的比赛距离，当其他人展示出事情如何轻易失控时，他从未看起来会失去比赛。
这个级别包括了三位在卡洛斯·塞恩斯、皮埃尔·加斯利和兰多·诺里斯中发挥最好的车手。
尽管奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂的排位赛表现没有麦克拉伦队友诺里斯那么出色，但在比赛中仅落后他一步，完成了领奖台，而且在从第17位发车后需要从罚站中恢复过来，这帮助他进入了这个级别。
威廉姆斯车队第八名完成者塞恩斯也克服了罚站，在第一圈就锁定了位置，并在整个比赛中在积分圈内徘徊，是唯一一位来自最快六支车队之外的车手得分。这与加斯利在保持在与更快车队同一组中取得第五名，为阿尔派赢得一个强劲的位置相似。
弗朗哥·科拉平托与他的最佳大奖赛成绩持平，以第六名的成绩结束了一场精彩的比赛，但他在资格赛和比赛中缺乏他的阿尔卑斯车队队友的优势，不得不坐在加斯利的下面。
奥利·贝尔曼从最后一排的处罚中恢复过来，以大约13名的成绩结束，足够高的成绩，足以让哈斯车队保持第七名的车队积分。
对于刘易斯·汉密尔顿和伊萨克·哈迪亚尔来说，他们的周末因为一系列不幸和处罚而受到影响，这些处罚并不是明显的错误，但必须计入他们的账上。
考虑到汉密尔顿在比赛中携带地板损坏，他的资格赛表现得很出色，在被法拉利车队的队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔推入旋转之前，他表现得很出色。然而，他之前因为离开赛道获得优势而被处以10秒处罚是可避免的，如果他只是合理地切角以防止碰撞，并归还位置的话。
至于哈达尔，他本来有机会赢得胜利，但在安全车阶段他的后备策略表现不佳，这意味着即使他没有前翼问题并赢得了比赛——他至少能进入前三——他也会因为被罚10秒而失去这个结果。
利亚姆·劳森在第八位顺利完成了资格赛，但比他的小红牛车队队友阿维德·林德布拉德落后两位，由于燃油泄漏导致他损失了一圈，他失去了在比赛中大放异彩的机会。即使安全车出动并帮他追回了一圈，他也没有时间重新加入车队，所以在那种情况下，从14位起步追回一些位置，虽然徒劳，但也是一种不错的表现。
奥迪车手们都度过了一个稳固的周末，加布里埃尔·博尔特洛托的情况尤其糟糕，但如果有车手能匹配萨因斯的比赛驾驶质量，也许会有一些积分机会，这将为博尔特洛托和尼科·胡肯伯格赢得中等水平的成绩。
至于费尔南多·阿隆索，那辆无望的阿斯顿·马丁给他提供的帮助很少，这使得很难公平地评价他，但考虑到他还有额外的动力单元问题，他至少有一个不错的周末。
拉斐尔·卡马拉被纳入这个小组，因为他虽然落后于哈斯车队的队友贝尔曼的速度，在缺乏经验和被塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯撞墙的情况下，他仍然完成了专业的工作。
兰斯·斯特罗尔和瓦尔特里·博塔斯都有足够的速度，但周末的表现并不突出，他们的速度不如队友快，但他们避免了犯下任何重大错误。这意味着他们因为不尽人意的但还算胜任的周末而在这个小组中。
安东内利的案例中，他因为在一个关键时刻的失误而滑入这个小组。虽然这是对规则的挫败，但他需要意识到这一点，这让他失去了胜利的机会。
他获得了杆位，但他承认，他的超级拖车更多是偶然而非有意策略，因为他在被迫进攻后，没有那个的话，他的排位赛速度并不特别出色。
亚历克斯·阿隆索是这个小组中不幸的车手，因为在排位赛中缺少拖车，加上刹车问题，他没有任何机会开始比赛。
这三个人在比赛中都犯了重大错误，这影响了他们的成绩，对于佩雷斯来说，他因此在下一次比赛中被处以五位的发车位置罚分。
乔治·拉塞尔速度快，他在比赛中大部分时间都在和维斯塔潘交换位置，试图找出如何进行最后的冲刺，但他从未到达那里，因为他滑到了队友安东内利的后面，然后在5号弯道犯了错误，最终撞到了墙上。因此，他以第九名的成绩完成了本可以赢得的比赛。
勒克莱尔在需要与法拉利队友合作时攻击汉密尔顿的愚蠢行为，加上尽管有下压力优势，他在排位赛中的表现似乎比汉密尔顿更差，这使得这个周末成为了一个难忘的周末。
林德布拉德在拉斯维加斯的比赛中表现相当出色，但被安全车卷入并因此错失重大胜利，这显然是一个新手犯的错误，它抵消了他之前所有的出色表现。虽然他提到了换挡问题，但最终这必须归咎于他的失误。
detailEn: Who actually did the best (and worst) job in Formula 1’s wild overtaking-fest Las Vegas Grand Prix?
Here’s Edd Straw’s judgement in his new tier list driver rankings format.

As usual, you can ask your questions about Edd's rankings by commenting on this post in The Race Members' Club - and have a crack at compiling your own Brazilian GP tier list with our handy visual tool!

Max Verstappen excelled in qualifying, as even though he only inherited pole position thanks to Kimi Antonelli’s penalty he was only behind in the initial results because of the Mercedes driver’s monster tow.
But it was the race that really marked Verstappen out: leading over 90% of it by distance and never looking like losing it when others showed how easy it was for things to unravel.
This tier includes a trio of drivers who got the most out of the race in Carlos Sainz, Pierre Gasly and Lando Norris.

And while Oscar Piastri’s qualifying performance wasn’t as sharp as McLaren team-mate Norris’s, finishing just behind him in the race as they completed the podium, the added complication of having to recover from 17th on the grid after a grid penalty helps to elevate him into this tier.

Williams’s eighth-place finisher Sainz also recovered from a penalty and after nailing the first lap, he spent the whole race in and around the points and was the only driver to score from outside the fastest half-dozen teams. That was similar to Gasly’s achievement in hanging in the group of quicker cars to bag a strong fifth place for Alpine.

Franco Colapinto matched his best grand prix result with sixth, driving a good race to cap a strong weekend, but has to sit a tier below Gasly as he lacked his Alpine team-mate’s edge in qualifying and the race.

Ollie Bearman recovered from a back-of-the-grid penalty to finish about as high as a Haas could have done in 13th, doing enough to trouble the Audi drivers to protect his team’s seventh place in the championship.
In the cases of Lewis Hamilton and Isack Hadjar, both had strong weekends undone by a mix of misfortune and penalties that weren’t overt errors but have to count against them.

Hamilton’s qualifying was well-executed given he carried floor damage and he raced well before being tipped into a spin by Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc, although the earlier 10-second penalty he was hit with for gaining an advantage by leaving the track was avoidable had he given the place back after justifiably cutting the corner to prevent a collision.

As for Hadjar, he was in the mix for victory but played the backing-up game poorly under the safety car, meaning even if he had not had the front wing problem and won the race - and he’d surely have been in the top three at least - he’d have lost the result to the 10-second penalty he was hit with.

Liam Lawson qualified decently in eighth, but that was two places behind Racing Bulls team-mate Arvid Lindblad, and he was denied the chance to make a big impact in the race by the fuel leak that cost him a lap. Even when the safety car was deployed and he got that lap back, he didn’t have time to rejoin the pack, so in that context making up some places to finish 14th represented a good, if fruitless, drive.

The Audi drivers both had solid weekends, Gabriel Bortoleto’s particularly blighted by problems, but there was perhaps a minor points opportunity had the drivers matched Sainz’s quality of race drive, earning both Bortoleto and Nico Hulkenberg a middling tier.

As for Fernando Alonso, the hopeless Aston Martin gave him little to work with and makes it difficult to evaluate him fairly, but he at least had a decent weekend given the additional power unit problems he had.

Rafael Camara is included in the group as while he was off Haas team-mate Bearman’s pace, in the circumstances of his lack of experience and being booted into the wall by Sergio Perez, he did a professional job.

Lance Stroll and Valtteri Bottas both had adequate but unremarkable weekends with their underlying pace not as sharp as their team-mates’, but they avoided making any significant errors. That means they are in this group for underwhelming, but competent, weekends.

In Antonelli’s case, he slips into this group because of the misjudgement he made in lifting at a key moment. While that’s a frustrating negative of the regulations, it was something he needed to be aware of and cost him a shot at victory.

He gets credit for pole position but he admitted that his monster tow was as much happenstance as a deliberate strategy after he was forced to attack, and without that his qualifying pace was nothing extraordinary.
Alex Albon is the unfortunate driver in this group with the lack of a tow in qualifying and no chance to start the race thanks to brake problems.
This trio all made significant errors in the race, which compromised their results and, in the case of Perez, earned him a five-place grid penalty for the next race.

George Russell was quick and spent a good part of the race swapping places with Verstappen and trying to work out how to play the final shootout, but never made it there as he slipped behind his team-mate Antonelli then made the Turn 5 error that ended up with him in the wall. He finished ninth in a race he could have won for that reason.

Leclerc’s foolishness in attacking Hamilton when co-operation with his Ferrari team-mate was needed, combined with the fact he seemed to struggle more in qualifying than Hamilton despite a downforce advantage, made this a weekend to forget.

So much of what Lindblad did in Las Vegas was superb, but spinning under the safety car and throwing away a big result was a rookie error that undid all of the good work. While he referenced a bad shift, ultimately this has to go down as his blunder.

items.summaryEn: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff says the "provocations" between his driver George Russell and Red Bull's Max Verstappen are a "good factor of the entertainment" in Formula 1.
detailZh: 梅赛德斯领队托托·沃尔夫表示，马克斯·维斯塔潘与乔治·拉塞尔的竞争是F1娱乐性的“好因素”。
马克斯·维斯塔潘与乔治·拉塞尔之间长期的不和在拉斯维加斯大奖赛上再度激化；拉塞尔在第三次练习赛中两人发生碰撞后批评了维斯塔潘；维斯塔潘在赢得分站冠军后嘲讽了退赛的拉塞尔。
马克斯·维斯塔潘在赢下拉斯维加斯大奖赛后，对老对手乔治·拉塞尔说了几句简短的话。
梅赛德斯领队托托·沃尔夫表示，旗下车手乔治·拉塞尔与红牛车手马克斯·维斯塔潘之间的“挑衅”是F1娱乐性的“好因素”。
两人之间的敌对情绪在拉斯维加斯大奖赛上再度燃起，最后一次练习赛中的碰撞之后，双方又爆发了一场口水战，这场口水战有可能在下周末的卡塔尔大奖赛上继续上演，天空体育F1频道将从周五开始直播。
在周六晚上的拉斯维加斯正赛之前，拉塞尔曾批评过维斯塔潘，随后两人在比赛中为领先位置展开了长时间的争夺，维斯塔潘最终夺冠，而拉塞尔在比赛后段出现失误——当时他试图超越队友安东内利升至第二——名次大幅下滑，最终以第九名完赛。
“他远低于我的水平”——马克斯·维斯塔潘嘲讽乔治·拉塞尔的失误

维斯塔潘当时在车队无线电中调侃了拉塞尔，随后在赛后新闻发布会上又抨击了这位梅赛德斯车手，声称“他远低于我的水平”。
在拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，乔治·拉塞尔在试图超越队友基米·安东内利时锁死轮胎撞上护栏，这让对手马克斯·维斯塔潘大为高兴。
沃尔夫在赛后、维斯塔潘出席新闻发布会之前发言，暗示这种竞争对这项运动有好处。
当被问及拉塞尔对维斯塔潘玩“心理战”是否是个坏主意时，沃尔夫回答说：“他们从卡丁车时代就认识彼此这么久了。”
“我觉得这大概有点像猫捉老鼠的游戏。”
乔治·拉塞尔对拉斯维加斯大奖赛最后一次练习中与马克斯·维斯塔潘的碰撞做出了回应，指责这位红牛车手“坑害”了他的对手。
“双方之间的这些挑衅也是娱乐性的另一个好因素。”
他们的恩怨几乎正好在两年后再次点燃，此前2024年卡塔尔大奖赛后曾爆发重大冲突，当时维斯塔潘认为拉塞尔为让干事处罚自己而施压过度，随后引发了一场引人注目的口水战。
2026年拉斯维加斯大奖赛精彩集锦
两人在最后一次练习中的碰撞发生在维斯塔潘超越拉塞尔之后，当时两人都在为飞驰圈做准备，拉塞尔认为这违反了车手之间的一项君子协定。
干事因造成碰撞而向维斯塔潘发出警告，拉塞尔接受这一结果并认为处理得当，但他坚持表示“总得有人站出来对抗那家伙”。
当被问及是否知道两人在事件发生后是否有过交谈时，沃尔夫表示：“我猜在赛事干事室里有一些交流。”
乔治·拉塞尔在拉斯维加斯大奖赛起步时与马克斯·维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔缠斗
维斯塔潘驾驶出色赢得比赛，他精准地管理能量部署，多次立即夺回领先位置。
在刘易斯·汉密尔顿确认离开梅赛德斯加盟法拉利后，沃尔夫曾公开向维斯塔潘示好，他对这位荷兰人的表现印象深刻。
"我认为马克斯是一位当之无愧的（比赛）获胜者。他没有犯任何错误，这就是他赢得比赛的原因。
"他总是能做出回应。一些非常出色的驾驶。"

detailEn: Max Verstappen rivalry with George Russell 'a good factor' of F1 entertainment, says Mercedes chief Toto Wolff

A long-standing feud between Max Verstappen and George Russell was reignited at the Las Vegas Grand Prix; Russell criticised Verstappen following a collision between the pair in final practice; Verstappen taunted Russell after winning the race as the Mercedes driver crashed out
Max Verstappen had a choice few words for long-time foe George Russell after winning the Las Vegas Grand Prix
Mercedes chief Toto Wolff says the "provocations" between his driver George Russell and Red Bull's Max Verstappen are a "good factor of the entertainment" in Formula 1.

Hostilities between the pair were renewed at the Las Vegas Grand Prix as a collision in final practice was followed by a war of words that threatens to continue at next weekend's Qatar Grand Prix, live on Sky Sports F1 from Friday.

After Russell had criticised Verstappen ahead of Saturday night's race in Las Vegas, the pair battled for the lead for much of the race, with Verstappen claiming victory as Russell finished ninth after a late error - made as he tried to pass his team-mate Kimi Antonelli for second - dropped the Brit down the field.
'He's so far below my level' - Max Verstappen taunts George Russell over error

Verstappen poked fun at Russell at the time over team radio and then laid into the Mercedes driver during the post-race press conference, claiming that "he's so far below my level".
George Russell hits the barrier after a lock-up when trying to overtake team-mate Kimi Antonelli at the Las Vegas Grand Prix, much to the delight of rival Max Verstappen
Wolff, who was speaking after the race but before Verstappen had spoken in the press conference, suggested the rivalry was good for the sport.
Asked whether it was a bad idea for Russell to engage in 'mind games' with Verstappen, Wolff replied: "They have known each other so long since karting.
"I think it's probably been a bit of cat and mouse.
George Russell reacted to the collision with Max Verstappen in final practice at the Las Vegas Grand Prix, accusing the Red Bull driver of of 'screwing' his rivals over
"These provocations in either side is another good factor of the entertainment."

Their feud has reignited almost exactly two years on from a major blow up following the 2024 Qatar Grand Prix, which saw a remarkable war of words follow an incident in which Verstappen felt Russell had pushed unreasonably hard to get him penalised by the stewards.
Highlights from the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix

The collision between the pair in final practice happened after Verstappen had overtaken Russell as the pair were both preparing for push laps, which Russell felt was in breach of a gentleman's agreement the drivers have.
The stewards gave Verstappen a warning for causing the collision, which Russell accepted as an appropriate outcome, but he insisted that "somebody's got to stand up to that guy".
Asked if he knew whether the pair had exchanged words following the incident, Wolff said: "I guess in the stewards' room there was a bit of an exchange."
George Russell tussles with Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar at the start of the Las Vegas Grand Prix
Verstappen drove superbly to win the race, managing his deployment expertly to immediately regain the lead on several occasions.
Wolff, who publicly courted Verstappen after it was confirmed Lewis Hamilton was leaving Mercedes to join Ferrari, was impressed by the Dutchman's display.
"I think Max is a deserving winner [of the race]. He made no mistakes, and that's why he won the race.
"He always had a response. Some very good driving."

detailZh: F1计划在2030年减少客户车队，随着关键细节的浮现
作为其2030年计划转向V8动力单元的一部分，一级方程式动力单元制造商将只为两支车队提供动力单元，这引发了关于梅赛德斯当前客户车队未来的政治阴谋
Motorsport.com了解到，F1计划在2030年每家制造商只提供两个动力单元，这引发了关于梅赛德斯目前三个客户车队状态的疑问
在拉斯维加斯周末，国际汽联宣布一致支持将下一代动力单元法规提前至2030年。这包括转向2.1升V8引擎，包括涡轮增压器，最大200千瓦的电力和可持续燃料的使用。
这项举措满足了对于更便宜、更简单的引擎的需求，这是国际汽联主席穆罕默德·本·苏莱姆和一级方程式主席斯蒂法诺·多米尼卡利共同追求的目标。同时，增加涡轮是奥迪等厂商的关键要求，这也确保了一级方程式在城市赛场的引擎噪音保持在合适的水平。
国际汽联发布的2030年框架广泛文件的一部分，但并未作为公开宣布的内容，是六家2030年动力单元制造商之间的一项协议，即每家厂商为两支车队提供动力单元，这也包括他们的厂队，仅剩一支车队可供外部客户车队使用。
Motorsport.com了解到，此举的一个目标是减少占据大部分车手阵容的制造商的政治影响力，在这种情况下是梅赛德斯-奔驰和法拉利，而相关制造商也愿意缩减规模，因为供应一级方程式引擎是一项亏损业务，供应量限制在每赛季仅1800万美元。
法拉利目前为厂队、哈斯和凯迪拉克提供动力单元，但后者将从2030年开始使用自家引擎，这意味着法拉利的供应问题将自行解决。红牛动力系统将为红牛车队和小红牛车队提供服务，而目前奥迪、阿斯顿·马丁的合作伙伴本田和凯迪拉克的股东通用汽车都将拥有他们唯一的确认客户——各自的厂队。
那留下了一个问题，梅赛德斯以及梅赛德斯高性能动力总成的客户将何去何从。在布拉克利克的工厂车队之外，布里克斯沃思运营目前正为麦克拉伦、威廉姆斯以及阿尔卑斯车队提供动力，而其母公司雷诺最近放弃了并出售了其内部发动机业务。
根据2030年的框架，如果国际汽联世界汽车运动理事会下个月在上海批准该提案，那么这三支车队中的两支将寻找新的发动机供应商。这一地震般的转变将在F1的 paddock中引发数月的政治阴谋，因为车队们争相确保自2014年F1转向混合动力引擎以来，一直是F1最可靠和性能最出色的动力单元供应商，或者与目前不那么受欢迎的选项达成交易。
Motorsport.com 了解到，麦克拉伦和威廉姆斯都希望继续与梅赛德斯合作。尽管麦克拉伦至少探索了成为自己的动力单元制造商的想法，当转向更便宜的公式会使这比现在更可行时，但首席执行官 Zak Brown 表示，2030年的船已经驶过，因为他希望继续作为梅赛德斯客户。
周四在拉斯维加斯，Brown 表示：“我们过去考虑过这件事，但我们非常满意高性能动力总成。我认为我们已经证明我们可以与他们赢得冠军，所以我们没有在车后放置任何东西的意图，除了梅赛德斯。”
Zak Brown关于麦凯轮自己制造引擎的想法："这是我们过去考虑过的事情，但我们非常满意HPP。我认为我们已经证明我们可以和他们一起赢得冠军，所以我们没有打算在我们的车上安装除了梅赛德斯引擎以外的任何东西。"
梅赛德斯对其理想客户车队的样子目前还不太清楚。在2024年和2025年被麦凯轮击败后，首席执行官Toto Wolff坚持认为，客户队的胜利仍然是HPP和整个梅赛德斯品牌的荣耀，同时一个强大的客户车队也为工厂运营提供了一个有价值的底盘基准。
尽管Brown称赞HPP是一个"了不起的合作伙伴"，但今年年初，由于工厂车队和客户之间在如何利用和部署复杂的新动力单元方面存在知识差距，HPP和麦凯轮之间的关系至少出现了一些紧张。
梅赛德斯是否会继续向其最强大的竞争对手租赁引擎，或者与中游车队达成协议是首选方案，这很可能会成为未来几个月内许多猜测的主题。
FIA提出的第三方引擎计划现在已经胎死腹中。随着2030年F1动力单元变得更加简单和便宜，FIA主席本·苏莱姆提出了一个想法，即采购一批现成的、白色标签的引擎，以进一步缓解对车队独立性的担忧。
然而，这个计划对任何潜在的引擎制造商来说似乎在经济上不可行，而现在所有六家PUM都一致同意2030年的关键基础设施，两个供应量的上限意味着至少有12个动力单元供应可供11支车队使用。
FIA还包含了一个安全网，以防其中一家制造商决定退出，增加了一条条款，即退出的制造商的F1动力单元知识产权将转让给FIA，然后FIA可以将其分配给新进入的制造商。
就像今天一样，还将有一个"供应义务"，这意味着FIA可以强迫一家制造商向一个额外的第三支车队提供引擎，如果该车队无法安排找到引擎的交易，这可能最终成为一条关键条款。
国际汽联主席穆罕默德·本·苏莱姆和F1首席执行官斯蒂法诺·多梅尼卡利长期以来一直就F1动力单元的未来发展方向达成一致。
双方还就2030-2034期间的动力单元成本上限达成一致。该上限将保持在今天的1.9亿美元，到2030年，每年将减少750万美元，到2034赛季结束时降至1.6亿美元。
这种滑动比例有助于制造商承担新动力单元的初期开发成本。预计从2028年开始对当前引擎的开发进行冻结，以及在该年夏季之前禁止V8动力测试，这将有助于F1的现有制造商在两个项目之间管理资源。现有制造商还将比新来者通用汽车获得更多的成本上限空间，通用汽车现在可以放弃其V6计划，仅专注于夏洛特的V8项目。据了解，通用汽车将签署前几年的预算上限为1.7亿美元。
制造商仍有一些重要议题需要进一步细化，例如电动推杆系统的确切性质，因为它需要与底盘设计协同工作以促进激烈的比赛。
但是，通过定义整体框架和关键引擎架构，这些将由FIA世界汽车运动理事会批准，制造商和FIA现在可以按照合理的时间表开始着手下一轮规则周期的工作。
这应该有助于管理机构制定出与新型动力单元良好配合的车架规则，提供一套更加纯粹和刺激的规则，而无需面对适应原始设备制造商突然转变的困境，这原本导致了2026年妥协且受到批评的公式。
detailEn: F1 set to reduce customer teams as key 2030 details emerge
As part of its 2030 plan to V8 power units, Formula 1 power unit manufacturers are set to only supply two teams, prompting political intrigue over the future of Mercedes' current customer teams
F1 is planning a shift to just two power unit supplies per manufacturer in 2030, Motorsport.com has learned, raising questions over the status of Mercedes' three current customers.

Over the Las Vegas weekend the FIA announced there was unanimous support to bring the next generation of power unit regulations forward to 2030. That includes a move to 2.1-litre V8 engines, including a turbocharger, a maximum of 200 kilowatts of electric power and the use of sustainable fuels.

That move satisfies the demand for cheaper and less complex engines, which FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem and F1 chief Stefano Domenicali had been pursuing in unison. Meanwhile, adding a turbo was a key requirement for the likes of Audi and also ensures engine noise remains at a suitable level for some of F1's urban venues.

What was also part of a wide-ranging document the FIA produced on the 2030 framework, but wasn't part of the public announcement, is an agreement between the six 2030 power unit manufacturers to supply just two teams each. This also includes their works team, leaving just one single engine supply available for external customer teams.

Motorsport.com understands that one aim of the move is to reduce the political influence of manufacturers supplying a large share of the grid, in this case Mercedes and Ferrari, while the manufacturers in question had also been willing to downsize as supplying F1 engines is a loss making operation, with supplies capped at just $18m per season.

Ferrari is currently supplying the works team, Haas and Cadillac, but the latter will be moving to in-house engines from 2030, meaning the question of Ferrari's supply is solving itself. Red Bull Powertrains will also be taking care of two teams, Red Bull Racing and Racing Bulls, while at present Audi, Aston Martin partner Honda and Cadillac's shareholder General Motors will all have their own works teams as their one and only confirmed customer.

That leaves the question of what will happen to Mercedes and the customers of Mercedes High Performance Powertrains. Alongside the works team in Brackley, the Brixworth operation is currently supplying McLaren, Williams as well as Alpine, whose parent company Renault recently abandoned and sold its in-house engine operation.

Per the 2030 framework, two of those three teams would be looking for a new engine supply if the FIA World Motor Sport Council approves the proposal in Shanghai next month. That seismic shift will set up months of political intrigue in the F1 paddock as teams scramble to secure what has been F1's most reliable and performant power unit supplier ever since F1 moved to hybrid engines in 2014, or conclude deals with currently less desirable options.

Motorsport.com understands that both McLaren and Williams are fancying their chances of remaining with Mercedes. And while McLaren at least explored the idea of becoming its own power unit manufacturer when a move to a cheaper formula would make that more feasible than it is now, CEO Zak Brown indicated that ship has sailed for 2030 as he aims to remain a Mercedes customer.

"It's something we've looked at in the past, but we're very happy with HPP," Brown said in Las Vegas on Thursday. "I think we've proven that we can win championships with them, so we don't have any intention to have anything in the back of our car other than a Mercedes."

Zak Brown on the idea of McLaren building its own engines: "It's something we've looked at in the past, but we're very happy with HPP. I think we've proven that we can win championships with them, so we don't have any intention to have anything in the back of our car other than a Mercedes."

Mercedes' intentions about what its ideal customer team would look like are less clear right now. Having been beaten by McLaren in 2024 and 2025, CEO Toto Wolff maintained that a win for a customer is still a feather in the cap for HPP and the Mercedes brand as a whole, while a strong customer team also provides a valuable chassis benchmark for the works operation.

And while Brown hailed HPP as an "awesome partner", it's no secret that the relationship between HPP and McLaren has at least come under some strain at the start of this year amid a knowledge gap between the works team and its customer over how to exploit and deploy the complex new power units.

Whether Mercedes will continue to lease engines to its most formidable rival or whether a deal with a midfield team is the preferred option will likely become the subject of plenty of intrigue in the coming months.

What is certain is that the FIA's proposed third-party engine plan is now dead in the water. With F1 power units becoming less complex and expensive in 2030, FIA president Ben Sulayem had floated the idea of sourcing a supply of off-the-shelf, white label engines to further alleviate concerns over team independence.

However, that plan never seemed economically viable for any prospective engine builder, and with all six PUMs at the table now unanimously agreeing to 2030's key infrastructure, a cap of two supplies would mean there are at least 12 power unit supplies available for 11 teams.

The FIA did include a safety net in case one of the six manufacturers decides to drop out, adding a clause under which a departing manufacturer’s F1 power unit intellectual property would transfer to the FIA, which could then assign it to a new manufacturer coming in.

As is the case today, there will also be an "obligation to supply", meaning the FIA could force one of the manufacturers to supply an additional, third team with an engine if that outfit can't arrange a deal to find one, which may well end up becoming a key clause.
FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem and F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali have long been in agreement over the future direction of F1's power units.

What has also been agreed is the basis for the power unit cost cap for the 2030-2034 period. The cap will remain at today's figure of $190m for 2030 before falling by $7.5m per year, ending at $160m for the 2034 season.

That sliding scale helps manufacturers with the initial development cost of the new power units. A development freeze of the current engines from 2028, as well as a ban on V8 dyno testing until the summer of that year, is expected to help F1's current manufacturers manage their resources between the two projects. Existing manufacturers will also receive more cost-cap headroom than newcomer General Motors, which can now abandon its V6 plans and just focus on the V8 program in Charlotte. GM is understood to be signing up to a budget cap of $170m for the first couple of years.

There are still several important topics to be fleshed out further by the manufacturers, such as the exact nature of the electric push-to-pass system as it would need to work in conjunction with the chassis design to promote close racing.

But by defining the overarching framework and key engine architecture, which will be rubber stamped by the FIA World Motor Sport Council, both the manufacturers and the FIA can now get to work on the next rules cycle on a reasonable timeline.

That should help the governing body come up with chassis regulations which are tuned to work well with the new power units and deliver a more pure and exciting set of rules, without facing the prospect of having to adapt to late U-turns by OEMs, which led to 2026's compromised and criticised formula to begin with.
